name: orchestrator
description: Pheonix Multi-Step Task Planner, Parallel Fan-Out/Fan-In Runner, Cooperative Cancellation, and Budget Guard

changes: MultiStepPlanner with cycle detection and Kahn's algorithm topological layer resolution
ParallelDAGRunner with ThreadPoolExecutor fan-out and join barrier synchronization
Cooperative CancellationToken allowing parallel tasks to run and be immediately stopped
BudgetGuard validating plan cost estimates and tracking step spending
SQLitePlanStore persistent state checkpointing and recovery
